description.narrative: Through the Water as Leverage Academy USA, the Government of the Netherlands aims to establish a structured trajectory that stimulates mutual learning, co-creation between Dutch and (a) USA city/cities, institutions, and practitioners inspired by Water as Leverage. The Academy provides a platform for mutual learning, cocreation and design, in which USA and Dutch partners co-develop approaches, test methodologies in real-world urban contexts, and jointly reflect on lessons learned to advance urban water resilience. This trajectory aims to contribute to strengthening institutional relationships, enhancing professional networks, and generating knowledge that is relevant to both countries and enriches the Water as Leverage methodology and toolkit. Explicit connections are envisaged with the Netherlands via Dutch platforms (e.g. NL2120), cities (Rotterdam, Amsterdam, others), governmental institutions and research organisations. This assignment lays contributes to the first step in the WaL-A USA activities in 2026 and 2027. Through the involvement of expert(s) from the University of Miami, the aim is to contribute to coordinated and integrated efforts in establishing the framework of collaboration as part of the WaL-A USA activities in Florida, with a likely focus on the Miami region. The specific expertise from the University of Miami is envisaged to contribute to the identification of key counterparts, identification of, and introduction with key institutions that could shape the bilateral partnership. Furthermore, the expertise is required to add information to the development of the Setting the Scene activities for Miami. For specific activities in the Florida region, the University of Miami is requested to play a convenor role, to ensure the successful development of the partnership(s) and timely entry points with the relevant governmental and non-governmental networks, including private sector and community organisations.This assignment is contracted by the Netherlands Enterprise Agency (RVO) and executed in close collaboration with the Ministry of Infrastructure and Water Management, the Netherlands embassy in the USA, the Consulate-General in Miami overseeing the bilateral activities in the area, and Deltares, Water as Leverage knowledge partner of the Dutch government.RemarkDue to the transparency with regard to the IATI projects, a non-ODA country is mentioned in this project.
